items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: And Bigfoot Billy was with it. ... I use Bigfoot Billy. ... Bigfoot, Billy, myself. We played all that, man.

ctx.x: Yeah. When I was doing trenchment work, I find horn and I passed the horn up myself. I passed the horn up. Sheep would tell you the same thing. Sheep had an old horn too. I'll tell you about this. Same time, when everybody's on the story, that, Sheep had an old horn, it was patched. It was all bent up. When I took the horn apart, I was doing metal work. I could do it good. I fixed the horn up. Yeah, not the horn could pick Howard. What Howard took and done. Howard took and, after I fixed the horn for Sheep,…
Man, you could let them go in the store there.

items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I use Bigfoot Billy. I use Charlie Anthony... We played all that man and people enjoyed that.

ctx.x: But you didn't take your case at your horn?

Yeah, I had my case right there with your good night. I'd take that one out and play nothing. You couldn't take it out? No. He'd take the time and he'd make you sit down there and he'd ask you questions. And now he'd ask you how many notes in music and how you divide the music. What are seven notes in music? In other words, four notes. You understand? You can make more than that. He'd ask you all them questions like that. Well, sometimes you wouldn't have your mind. He kept you on a snap journey to catch you…

back in town, Ruben, Ruben they called him. Ruben, Ruben can tell you. Well we had about nine pieces and Dave, well Dave Band was up there too playing. And so Dave, uh, Dave was telling me. So I'm gonna tell you man, I got up there, Mike I swear to Jesus Christ boy, there was there and Bigfoot Billy was with it. Stay down there, I'm trying to never man you sure be asking me that. So Mike, Mike seen Dave with Dave Band, Dave played a couple of them. Man he said no lie Mike, I'm not lying. Mike in California, Mike…

items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: He had one of the sideway too. You know, not the big old head like Timber got.

ctx.x: tall man. That's right. That man could play up some music. Woo! He had one of the sideway too. You know, not the big old head like Timber got. He wasn't old side too. He wasn't leaning over like that. And make you healthy Uphight too. Uphight too. Uphight. Uphight. yes ma'am it give you all the oppression in the world for y'all. Listen at the man play a bass. Come on Keith. And that time Old Horford put that light on that keyboard by the bed. Look that time yeah that time Old Horford was playing trample with him.…

Man that was some kick them did. See the musician done the thing there? The boy was in the truck doing that. You understand any of them? You'd get yourself in trouble for that. That's when they got the union. You'd do something like that. You'd just have no word trouble for the union. And them fellas would be taking money. They'd take your deposit you know. Well Chris Kelly, you'd do the same with it too. He would do that with it too? Yeah he'd done that with it. He'd done that too. Take deposit. When they go to…
